You didn't ask for it. Did you still create it?

Kevin Trudeau says he asked the universe to free him from his companies so he could focus on his mission and his writing. What arrived was a set of circumstances he never pictured.

His view: you manifest what you need, not always the method you expected. Some things are off your radar and you have to trust them.

So he asks you to see it differently. It isn't happening to you. It's happening for you.

What hard thing in your life might be happening for you?
